changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [dbo].[CatalogBrowseSubject] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS select I.ID as IntersectId, I.ObjectAssetID, I.SubjectAssetId, CAST(ADV_Subject.DisplayValue as nvarchar(4000)) as SubjectDisplayValue, P.Id as PredicateId from dbo.[Predicate] P inner join dbo.[IntersectType] IT on IT.PredicateID = P.ID inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue ADV_Subject on ADV_Subject.AssetID = I.SubjectAssetID where P.Type = 5;
